nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: The project's primary AI-agent instructions and architecture reference for WICLOUD: stack decisions, the cool/signal color system and its contrast rules, the content model (site_content/site_solutions, lib/data/services.ts + media.ts), the full homepage section-by-section build notes (Hero, UniverseReveal, DeviceShowcase, etc.), and the /dashboard + /admin platform (auth, permissions, billing, demos, quotas, realtime).
nodes.languageNotes: Regenerated in part by `next dev` (a block at the top is machine-managed); the rest is hand-written, load-bearing tribal knowledge with explicit 'don't simplify this back' warnings throughout.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: One-line pointer (`@AGENTS.md`) that makes Claude Code load AGENTS.md as the project's instructions.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Default create-next-app boilerplate readme (getting-started dev command, links to Next.js docs, and Vercel deploy instructions); not updated for the WICLOUD-specific stack or route groups.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Root package manifest for the wisscreen (WICLOUD) Next.js 16 app: dev/build/lint/test/typecheck scripts, Drizzle migration and Neon-deploy scripts, and the dependency set (HeroUI v3, Drizzle ORM, Better Auth, @react-three/fiber, GSAP, @neon/config, @neon/env, @react-pdf/renderer, Resend).

nodes.name: pnpm-workspace.yaml
nodes.summary: pnpm install-policy configuration only (not a true monorepo): allows esbuild's postinstall build script while blocking sharp/unrs-resolver, and excludes the pinned Next.js 16.3.2 packages from pnpm's minimum-release-age quarantine.

nodes.name: skills-lock.json
nodes.summary: Lock file pinning the source and content hash of each installed Neon agent-skill (neon, neon-auth, neon-postgres, neon-postgres-branches, neon-postgres-egress-optimizer, neon-functions, neon-object-storage, neon-ai-gateway), all sourced from the neondatabase/agent-skills GitHub repo.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the Next.js App Router project: ES2017 target, strict mode, bundler module resolution, the Next.js TS plugin, and the `@/*` path alias to the repo root.
